RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of bias, just as an all-male panel does not prove discrimination. In senior banking roles like Head of Risk Modelling, executive leadership and regulatory affairs experience often outweigh purely quantitative credentials, making the appointed candidate's profile highly competitive.

Accusing the panel of sex discrimination without concrete evidence will appear unprofessional and could damage your industry reputation. Furthermore, a two-week delay in feedback is standard corporate latency, not an indicator of wrongdoing.

Instead of raising gender, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on specific competencies you can develop for future leadership opportunities. Focus on maintaining positive professional relationships.
